title: The Tide of the Old Mill House
author: Juniper Lockridge
blurb: Xanthe Eastwick, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
